now.title: Spider-Noir
now.text: Cat Hardy hires Ben to find Flint Marko while hiding her own plot against Silvermane. They become lovers and she works out that he is the Spider, but she gives his secret to Dr. Faber. When Silvermane later holds Ben, Cat admits her plot against Silvermane to protect him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's client and lover, who betrays him, then protects him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The private eye Cat hires, falls for and betrays.

proposed.text: Ben is hired to dig up dirt on Cat Hardy and tries to sell her the photos, until her bodyguard Flint Marko attacks him. After Marko goes missing, Cat hires Ben to find him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A singer who hires Ben to find her missing bodyguard.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The private eye Cat hires to find Marko.

split.title: Spider-Noir#4
split.text: Cat tells Ben she hired Addison to kill Silvermane. They spend the night together, and she works out that he is the Spider.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's lover, who works out he is the Spider.

split.title: Spider-Noir#5
split.text: Ben asks Cat to leave the city with him and she agrees, but when she hears Dr. Faber may need the Spider for a cure, she tells Faber who he is.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's lover, who gives his secret to Dr. Faber.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Cat's lover, whose secret she gives away.

split.title: Spider-Noir#8
split.text: When Silvermane threatens to kill Cat to make Ben confess, she admits she betrayed Silvermane to protect Ben. In the end she chooses Marko.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A former lover who protects Ben from Silvermane, then chooses Marko.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The private eye Cat protects from Silvermane.

changes.evidence: The stage starts at episode 1, where Ben is hired to tail Cat, tries to blackmail her, fights Marko, and the next day Cat hires him to find Marko. Her plot against Silvermane comes out in #3/#4 (she tells Ben she hired Addison in #4), they spend the night and she deduces he is the Spider in #4, she gives his secret to Faber in #5, and she admits betraying Silvermane to protect Ben in #8.

now.title: Spider-Noir
now.text: Janet Ruiz is Ben's secretary and fellow investigator, and she works his cases with him. In the end she becomes his partner in Reilly and Ruiz Investigations.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's secretary, then his partner in the agency.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Janet's boss, then her partner in the agency.

proposed.text: Janet Ruiz is Ben's secretary and fellow investigator, and she works his cases with him.

split.title: Spider-Noir#8
split.text: After the case is over, Ben makes Janet his full partner, and the agency becomes Reilly and Ruiz Investigations.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's secretary, now his partner in the agency.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Janet's boss, now her partner in the agency.

changes.evidence: Janet is Ben's secretary from episode 1; the office is renamed Reilly and Ruiz Investigations only at the end of episode 8 (#8 'The Man in the Mask').

now.title: Spider-Noir
now.text: Robbie Robertson is Ben's friend, a journalist who digs into the same case. He pushes Ben to help the other metahumans, cures Lonnie Lincoln and even poses as the Spider to protect him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's journalist friend, who even poses as the Spider to protect him.

proposed.text: Robbie Robertson is Ben's friend, a journalist who digs into the same case.

split.title: Spider-Noir#7
split.text: Robbie pushes Ben to help the other metahumans, and when the Spider struggles against Lonnie Lincoln, Robbie stabs Lincoln in the eye with the cure.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's journalist friend, who cures Lincoln.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Robbie's friend, the Spider, whom he pushes to help others.

split.title: Spider-Noir#8
split.text: When Silvermane forces Ben to bring in the Spider, Robbie shows up in the Spider's mask to protect him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's journalist friend, who even poses as the Spider to protect him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Robbie's friend, the Spider, whom he poses as.

changes.evidence: Robbie appears from episode 1 as Ben's journalist friend; he urges Ben to help the other metahumans and injects Lincoln with the cure in #7 'Nobody's Hero', and arrives dressed as the Spider at the Alcove in #8.

now.title: Spider-Noir
now.text: Flint Marko is Cat's bodyguard, and she hires Ben to find him after he disappears. Marko fights Ben more than once, the last time as Silvermane's enforcer, but in the end Ben gives him the last dose of the cure so he can be with Cat.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Cat's lover and bodyguard, who gets Ben's last cure.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The private eye who gives Marko the last dose of the cure.

proposed.text: Flint Marko is Cat's bodyguard. He fights Ben over the photos of Cat, and after Marko goes missing, Cat hires Ben to find him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Cat's bodyguard, whom Ben is hired to find.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The private eye Marko fights over the photos of Cat.

split.title: Spider-Noir#8
split.text: Now Silvermane's enforcer, Marko fights the Spider beside Leyden, but turns on Leyden when he attacks Cat. Ben gives Marko the last dose of the cure so he can be with Cat.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Cat's lover, who gets Ben's last cure.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The private eye who gives Marko the last dose of the cure.

changes.evidence: In episode 1 Marko, Cat's bodyguard, follows Ben for the negatives and fights him; Cat then hires Ben to find him. Cat and Marko's love comes out in #3/#4, and the final street fight, Marko turning on Leyden and Ben giving him the last antidote are all in #8.

now.title: Spider-Noir
now.text: Silvermane rules New York's underworld, and Ben keeps crossing him on his case. As the Spider, Ben scares him into leaving him and Janet alone, but Silvermane later captures Ben and learns who he is.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The mob boss Ben keeps crossing.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The private eye who turns out to be the Spider.

proposed.text: Silvermane rules New York's underworld, and Ben keeps crossing him on his case.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A private eye who keeps crossing Silvermane.

split.title: Spider-Noir#2
split.text: Silvermane's men try to take Ben to him. As the Spider, Ben attacks Silvermane's car and scares him into leaving Ben and Janet alone.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The mob boss Ben scares off as the Spider.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The private eye who keeps crossing Silvermane.

split.title: Spider-Noir#8
split.text: Silvermane has Ben brought to him to reach the Spider, and when Leyden recognizes Ben from the war, Silvermane realizes Ben is the Spider.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The mob boss who learns Ben is the Spider.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The private eye Silvermane learns is the Spider.

changes.evidence: Ben returns as the Spider and intimidates Silvermane into leaving Ben and Janet alone in #2 'Tread Lightly'; Silvermane captures Ben and realizes he is the Spider after Leyden recognizes him in #8. The stage itself starts at episode 1.
